Power washing

Blue Fox Landscape & Services provides pressure washing services to remove dirt, stains, and grime from residential and commercial properties.

Free estimatesResidential & commercialLake Mary & Central FL
Get estimate Call 407-717-8191

What this is

Power washing in Lake Mary, FL and the surrounding areas.

We pay attention to the detail and to your complete satisfaction with the result. Pressure washing is the highest-return hour anyone spends on a property: nothing else takes something that looks like it needs replacing and makes it look new for the price of a visit.

It is also the service where the difference between operators is most visible afterwards. Lap marks on a driveway, a striped fence, etched concrete and a wand held too close are all permanent, and they all come from rushing.

What we wash

Three surfaces, three methods.

The method follows the surface. That is the whole discipline, and getting it backwards is how exteriors get damaged.

01

Driveways & walkways

The largest and dirtiest hard surface on the property, and the one your kerb appeal actually rests on. Oil, tyre marks, organic staining and the grey film that makes new concrete look ten years old.

02

Patio & deck

The surfaces people sit on, which is why they get judged closest. Cleaned at a pressure appropriate to the material rather than a single setting for everything.

03

Fence & gate

Vertical surfaces streak if they are worked in the wrong order. Done properly a fence goes back several shades and stays even.

Questions

Before you call.

What is the difference between power washing and soft washing?

Pressure. Power washing uses high-pressure water on hard surfaces that can take it — concrete, pavers, some decking. Soft washing uses low pressure plus a cleaning solution for surfaces that cannot — roofs, siding, gutters. Using the wrong one is how surfaces get damaged, so we treat them as two separate services.

Is the estimate free?

Yes. Contact Blue Fox Landscape & Services for your free power washing estimate today.

Do you do commercial properties?

Yes — residential and commercial power washing both.
